# Nahum Chapter 1 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A) | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NAH_001_page_001.jpg

---

**1:1** The-oracle [massa] of-Nineveh [Nineveh]. The-book [sefer] of-the-vision [chazon] of-Nachum [Nahum] the-Elqoshite [ha-Elqoshi].

**1:2** A-God [El] jealous [qanno] and-avenging [noqem] [is] YHWH; avenging [noqem] [is] YHWH and-a-master of-wrath [ba'al chemah]; avenging [noqem] [is] YHWH against-his-adversaries [le-tsarav], and-he-keeps [noter] [wrath] for-his-enemies [le-oyvav].

**1:3** YHWH [is] slow [erekh] of-anger [appayim] and-great [u-gdol] of-power [koach], and-YHWH will-by-no-means [naqqeh lo yenaqqeh] leave-unpunished. In-whirlwind [be-sufah] and-in-storm [u-vi-s'arah] [is] his-way [darko], and-cloud [anan] [is] the-dust [avaq] of-his-feet [raglav].

**1:7** Good [tov] [is] YHWH as-a-stronghold [le-ma'oz] in-the-day of-distress [tsarah]; and-he-knows [veyodea] those-who-take-refuge [chosei] in-him.
